display_name: 固定 SIG_TIME 教师置信度次序源域证伪：六模型，无模型更新
description: One fixed truth-free FP32 confidence-order rule, full-batch-denominator feature derivative on L and no-gradient V qualification; no threshold scan, training or query access.
authorization: User requests training-mechanism DG/SSL research with fixed SIG_TIME/default joint head. This fixed all-six-model source-only falsification has no training, fitted head or new target access.

code.environment: native verified Python / ordinary N607 CVS-RFFI fullFP32 CPU2threads

data.representation: existing normalized raw/post_sync/noeq source IQ2x256, immutable L/V source cache, physical IDs unchanged; existing NoExplicitCFO actual identity path

roles.L_s: 6300 approved sourceL, readonly gradients on same strong graph, 0 parameter updates
roles.V: 27000 approved source validation, no_grad forward for fixed confidence-policy falsification; 0 fitting/gradients/model updates

data.capsule_id: existing VALIDATED_ONCE Phase1 clean capsule, unchanged physical IDs

permissions.claim_scope: Fixed confidence-order source proxy only; V is never fitted/backpropagated; no real U accuracy, training efficacy, target DG, newTX or Phase2 claim

checkpoint.initialization: All predetermined fixedSIG ZERO and FEATURE_MT final50 students plus their actual ownEMA; readonly, no training initialization
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Existing source_proof checks actual full role contract and same fixed scratch33+17/11100 final50; ownEMA epoch50/11100 required before loading; no target-selected parent
checkpoint.selection_rule: All6 arms x predefined seeds, no ranking by target scores

execution.gpu_policy: CPU only CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES empty; one serial process2 OMP/MKL/OpenBLAS/Torch threads; no GPU allocation
execution.stop_rule: Any run-owned source/provenance/role/query/default-head/nonfinite/state mutation/output conflict stops only this diagnostic and preserves partial artifacts with failure.json; no automatic retry. Scientific qualification FAIL is reported, never repaired by threshold scans or selective reruns.

metrics_plan.primary: V helpful retention > harmful retention for ALL six fixed models; both groups nonempty in every model
metrics_plan.rule: FP32 max softmax(ownEMA weak) >= max softmax(student strong), ties kept; detached, gap threshold 0 only
metrics_plan.denominator: All L original/gated/group feature derivatives use full batch N, never retained count
metrics: All L6300 and V27000 policy/group/retention/ties per model
L trueCE/feature/.1 effective and gated feature gradients; batch and count-weighted global vectors
Original versus gated feature against full-group trueCE, explicit denominator and empty group semantics

rows.seed_notes: All predefined 3 seeds x2 arms, same L/V physical data and views across models; L shuffle/noise2026101501/02, V2026101503/04; no threshold/model/seed selection
rows.scenario: L gradients and V no_grad fixed confidence-order probe, ownEMA weak/student original strong .015+dropout
rows.budget_ref: 0 extra model epochs/optimizer/head updates; per model L6300+V27000=33300 source observations,66600 forward packet observations/262 forward batches,25 L derivative batches/75 layer records/1200 vectors; V gradient0
